answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 148133 Country: INDIA Title: Can we pay the dues by taking zakah? Question: Can we take zakah from the person whose dues (qarz) is due on me and I am not in a position to pay the dues (qarz) and I am taking the zakah in the intention to pay the dues (qarz) of the same person. Is it possible to do the same? Answer ID: 148133 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 84/245/SD=4/1438) Yes, if you are not sahib-e-nisab then you can take zakah from the said person and pay off your debt. According to Shariah it is lawful. وحيلة الجواز أن يعطى مديونه الفقير زكاته ، ثم يأخذها عن دينه، ولو امتنع المديون مد يده وأخذها لكونه ظفر بجنس حقه . (الدر المختار مع الشامي/ كتاب الزكاة 3/190 زكريا) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
